scene: Turning the key unveils three bustling transport docks outside the station.
picture: A flat side-view along the station concourse. On the left, a koi-shaped boat bobs in an indoor canal. In the centre, the grandfather stands holding his bicycle with plant crate beside a green ivy-covered tram. On the right, a shiny vintage streetcar waits beside an open archway, facing forward.
shown: A carved orange koi-shaped boat floating in a tiled basin on the left
A green garden tram covered in ivy idling quietly at centre
A red-and-cream retro streetcar waiting by a striped sign on the right
